name: Chandra, Chill of Compliance
description: An Echoverse version of Chandra Nalaar who is a measured, calm Avishkar consul shieldguard with cryomancy, and has embraced the Theorist's vision.

relations.quote: Chandra has embraced the Theorist's meticulous vision for all of reality.

relations.note: Pia raised Chandra apart from the Consulate.
relations.quote: Pia believed it was best to raise Chandra far from the Consulate's influence.
